body:
Adds a configurable cooldown to Ender Pearls to prevent spamming and improve gameplay balance.

✨ Features
⏳ Adds a cooldown after throwing an Ender Pearl
⚙️ Easily configurable cooldown time via command
👥 Applies to all players
🧩 Lightweight and simple to use
🛠️ Commands
/pearl cooldown <time> — Set the cooldown duration
Use s for seconds (e.g., 10s)
Use m for minutes (e.g., 2m)
📌 Examples
/pearl cooldown 10s → sets cooldown to 10 seconds
/pearl cooldown 2m → sets cooldown to 2 minutes
🎮 How it works

After a player throws an Ender Pearl, they must wait until the cooldown expires before using another one.
